_readme: Support resources shown by Roohvi. Every record carries a source and a verification note. Phone numbers and availability change: always tell the user to confirm. Edit freely; add your own region.

records.name: Police (15)
records.availability: Punjab Police lists 15; Karachi Police lists 'Madadgar 15' as a 24/7 helpline.
records.last_verified: 2026-10-03 (Amir Khan, official sites; pending team review)

records.name: Rescue 1122 (Sindh, incl. Karachi)
records.availability: Sindh Rescue 1122 started in 2022 with a single free helpline 1122; reach may vary by district while it expands
records.last_verified: 2026-10-04 (Business Recorder report; not yet checked on a Sindh government site)
records.source: Business Recorder report on Sindh Rescue 1122
records.note: If 1122 does not connect where you are, call Police 15.

records.name: Umang Mental Health Helpline
records.availability: 24/7 per umang.com.pk and several independent directories
records.note: A helpline is not a substitute for emergency services: if you are in immediate danger, call emergency services first.

records.name: Rozan Counselling Helpline
records.availability: Hours UNVERIFIED: Rozan's pages disagree (Mon-Fri 9-5 on one, 10-8 daily on an old page). Check rozan.org.
records.last_verified: 2026-10-03 (Amir Khan, official site; pending team review)
records.note: Counselling, not an emergency service. The toll-free number appears in a Punjab government referral directory but not on Rozan's own current pages, so confirm it. Normal mobile call charges may apply to the mobile number.

records.name: Taskeen Health Initiative
records.availability: Mon-Sat, 11 am to 11 pm, free telephone support (per taskeen.org)
records.last_verified: 2026-10-03 (Amir Khan, official site; pending team review)
records.note: Does not diagnose or do formal evaluations.

records.name: Ministry of Human Rights Helpline 1099 (abuse, violence, legal advice)
records.availability: Free. Press coverage describes it as a 24-hour line; confirm hours on mohr.gov.pk
records.note: For domestic violence, abuse and other rights violations: free legal advice and referral. If you are in danger right now, call emergency services first.

records.name: Find A Helpline
records.note: Free, confidential crisis lines by country and language.

records.name: Local emergency number
records.note: If you are in immediate danger, contact local emergency services.

_change_log_2026-10-03: Rescue 1122: removed the note that 112 also works (no official source). Availability outside Punjab unverified.
Rozan: removed toll-free 0800-22444 (not confirmed on Rozan's current pages); number 0304-111-1741 per Amir Khan; hours conflict between pages.
All PK entries updated from Amir Khan's PRO research (official sites, 3 Oct 2026); PENDING review by Maria. Sindh/Karachi emergency numbers still missing: needs an official source.
_change_log_2026-10-04: Added province-aware records: PK-PB and PK-SD. Sindh helpline for mental health (Sindh Mental Health Authority) exists per a directory but no verified number yet, so it is not listed.
_change_log_2026-10-04b: Added MoHR helpline 1099 (official site). Re-added Rozan toll-free 0800-22444 because a Punjab government referral directory lists it; still confirm with Rozan.
